name: Rue:barbe -- modal split counter
tagline: Manually count passing bike, pedestrian and cars and calculate the modal split.
blurb: Simple application to count the passing vehicules in the street.
description:
Simple application to count the passing vehicules in the street.
It can be used for bike advocacy campaign (for example, to report
number of bikes passing on a given street).

Features:

* simple no-frills interface
* no login required
* stores the counting results locally on the device
* automatically retrives and stores location (optional)
* calculate modal split
* free and open source (GPL licensed)
